entities.summary: Apti Khamzatovich Aukhadov is a Russian weightlifter competing in the 85 kg category. He is a Chechen of the Bashtaroi teip. Apti Aukhadov was a athletes & competitors from Urus-Martan (b. 1992-11-18, Urus-Martan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
